subject.title: fix(tasks): reset omitted lifecycle start time

question: Should bundled plugins that emit a reserved lifecycle start without a finite producer timestamp now receive an explicit rejection?
rationale: Supported producers already comply and the implementation is coherent, but this intentionally changes an exposed bundled-plugin API result for malformed payloads and therefore needs owner confirmation.

options.title: Confirm strict rejection
options.body: Treat finite startedAt as mandatory for reserved lifecycle starts, fix the sibling test fixture, and merge after checks pass.

options.title: Preserve apparent acceptance
options.body: Remove or narrow plugin-side rejection if the existing success result for malformed bundled-plugin payloads must remain compatible.

recommendation.title: Confirm strict rejection
recommendation.body: Treat finite startedAt as mandatory for reserved lifecycle starts, fix the sibling test fixture, and merge after checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent substantial work on the shared agent-event infrastructure makes this the strongest available owner for the compatibility choice.
